verdict.rationale: Slack's own AI features generate insights from workspace data inside the product. These include the 'Today' briefing, which flags what needs your attention based on your priorities, Slackbot as an AI agent that analyzes reports and prepares briefs, AI channel and thread summaries with daily recaps, and AI huddle notes with takeaways and action items. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth first-party documentation beyond marketing pages on how the suggestions are generated and how far they go.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Today is your new intelligent briefing that signals what needs your attention based on your priorities.
Slackbot is your personal AI agent in Slack that understands you and your workspace, helping you prepare for upcoming meetings, analyze reports, and create project briefs.
AI in Slack can summarize channels and threads and serve up daily recaps, giving you the information you need to stay organized and in the know.
Key takeaways, action items, and who said what are all neatly organized when the huddle ends
Slackbot can now dig deep on open-ended questions, not just quick ones.
